item.title: De Profundis: Oscar Wilde in Jail — Sun Nov 15, 1:30 PM — Soulpepper Theatre
item.description:
“There is no prison in any world into which love cannot force an entrance.”
This November, Soulpepper Theatre is thrilled to bring back their award-winning musical adaptation of DE PROFUNDIS: OSCAR WILDE IN JAIL
The musical begins with Oscar Wilde languishing in a prison cell, cut off from the world that once adored him. As he writes a letter to the man he loved—memory, regret, and desire crowd the silence—turning confinement into confession.
In this intimate, 90-minute musical fantasy, Robbie Ross and Bosie emerge through Wilde’s fractured memories as as the plot thickens and audience are carried away by the original, genre-spanning score that moves from Irish ballads to Broadway and electro-pop.
Weaving together Wilde’s trial testimonies, letters and epigrams, De Profundis reveals Wilde unmasked: lover, icon and exile—insisting that even in the darkest places, love can still reach us.
Onstage at Soulpepper Theatre for a limited run from November 3rd- November 29th

item.title: How to CRUSH a 1st Date — Mon Nov 23, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! Whether you met them on a dating app or in real life.. You will have to go on a first date at some point (if you’re lucky, so many flakes). So how do you make sure that you have the best first date ever and avoid the common pitfalls and awkward moments.
Join me for a free 60-minute live webinar built for single people who want to feel more confident from the first message to the follow-up.
**In this session, you’ll learn:**
* How to text before the date without overthinking it * How to plan a first date that makes conversation easy * The simple rules that make a great impression * Which topics to skip (and what to talk about instead) * When and how to initiate touch, respectfully * How to kindly let someone down if it’s not a match * When to follow up after the date, and what to say
You’ll leave with a clear plan for every stage of a date, plus a chance to ask your own questions live.
**Who it’s for:** Single adults who want more confidence and less gues

item.title: 🍁🌿 Fall Hike: East Don Trail Adventure 🍪🥾 — Sat Nov 28, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! # **Toronto’s Newest Ravine Trail, Autumn Scenery & Fresh-Baked Cookies!**
Did you join us for our last East Don Trail adventure? People had such a great time, and there was plenty to talk about afterward! Now that fall is here, we’re heading back to enjoy the trail in autumn. Join us as we explore the **East Don Trail**, one of Toronto’s newest additions to its incredible ravine system.
This beautiful route follows the East Don River through peaceful forests, wetlands, and scenic valley landscapes, connecting communities that were once separated. If you’ve walked the Lower Don Trail, this is a different experience.
Expect quieter pathways, river views, new bridges, and the feeling of discovering another corner of Toronto that many people have yet to explore.
Most of the route is paved and relatively easy to walk. Just one warning: what goes down must come up! 😄

item.description: Who says you can’t grow a garden in the winter? Winter sowing is an easy and inexpensive way to start native seeds. Through this simple method of sowing seeds during the colder months, you can plan your garden to support butterflies, bees and birds. In this workshop, learn how surprisingly easy it is to grow native wildflowers from seed if we follow nature’s lead by embracing the cold! Participants can take some seed packets home for your garden or balcony.
